summary: Responsive design pass (375px / 768px / 1280px) tested via Playwright across Home, Nosotros, Eventos, Estadisticas, Noticias, Contacto. Password toggle buttons (registro-equipo + LoginModal) confirmed 44x44px. Navbar.jsx hamburger toggles correctly at 375 & 768 and shows horizontal nav at 1280 on all pages EXCEPT Home. Two issues found: (1) Desktop 1280 Home has horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=1296) caused by carousel arrow buttons positioned at -right-10 in home-finales section. (2) Home page uses its own inline embedded navbar (not the shared Navbar.jsx) which does NOT collapse into a hamburger on mobile/tablet as the request requires — it only flex-wraps into 2 rows. Additionally on Eventos mobile the 3-col TabsBar (FESTIVAL/EVENTOS/PREMIER) forces awkward mid-word wrapping and the middle 'EVENTOS' + 'Diseñados para ti' subtitle visually spill beyond its cell (no page overflow but ugly).

ui_bugs.issue: Desktop 1280px: document.body.scrollWidth=1296 > viewport 1280 → horizontal scroll appears. Cause: prev/next carousel buttons use 'absolute -right-2 lg:-right-10' / '-left-10'. At viewport exactly 1280 the max-w-7xl (1280) container touches the edges so -right-10 pushes the button 40px past the right edge. Needs clamp (e.g. change lg:-right-10 to lg:right-2 or wrap section with overflow-x-hidden).

Home page has its own inline navbar (App.js: {!isHome && <Navbar />}) that uses flex-wrap and does NOT collapse to a hamburger on mobile (375) or tablet (768). Screenshot shows 2-row wrap. The responsive spec asked hamburger on mobile+tablet — this navbar was NOT updated in this session (only /app/frontend/src/components/Navbar.jsx was). Data-testid 'nav-mobile-toggle' does not exist on '/'.

3-col grid forces awkward wrap: 'FESTIV/AL', 'PREMIE/R', and the center tab text 'EVENTOS Diseñados para ti' visually overflows its cell overlapping adjacent buttons. No page scrollWidth overflow but visually unclean. Consider stacking (grid-cols-1) or hiding subtitle on mobile.

issues: Middle tab 'EVENTOS / Diseñados para ti' overlaps neighboring tab buttons
Carousel arrows outside container cause 16px horizontal scroll

action_items: Fix Home.jsx home-finales carousel arrow positioning (replace lg:-right-10/-left-10 with values that stay inside the viewport, or add overflow-x-hidden to the section wrapper) to eliminate the 1296px desktop scrollWidth.

Apply the hamburger/responsive pattern from Navbar.jsx to the Home page's embedded hero-nav-bar (Home.jsx lines ~161-201), OR replace it with the shared <Navbar /> on small screens. Currently mobile & tablet Home nav is NOT hamburger.
Improve Eventos mobile TabsBar: either grid-cols-1 on mobile, or reduce padding/hide the 'Diseñados para ti' subtitle at 375px so text doesn't overlap between tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx duplicates navbar logic instead of reusing Navbar.jsx — root cause of the missed responsive pass on '/'.
Using negative offsets (-right-10) without overflow-x-hidden on parent is fragile; container at max width will always overflow the viewport.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: Navbar.jsx hamburger works on mobile+tablet for /nosotros /eventos /datos-estadisticas /noticias /contacto; horizontal nav shows on desktop. Password toggle 44x44 confirmed on /registro-equipo AND LoginModal. No horizontal overflow on any page except Desktop Home (/). Eventos overflow on 375 and 768 is FIXED (sw==iw). Escenarios/Premiacion titles look fine on mobile. Two remaining issues to retest after main agent fixes: (1) Home carousel arrow overflow desktop, (2) Home embedded navbar hamburger.
